title: Time-travelling Nordic humans manipulating history

tellings.quote: continuity. We are dealing with people who achieved time travel at some point.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, says on a podcast that some of the beings people report, tall and Nordic-looking, are in fact humans from the future who achieved time travel somewhere after the year 2050. According to Jorjani, drawing on a work called Closer Encounters, these travellers act across Earth, the Moon and Mars and have been shaping human history. If true, our past would partly be the work of our own descendants.
